text: For an n-dimensional space V, the symmetric algebra Sym(V) is isomorphic to the ___ ring F[x₁, …, xₙ].
explanation: Choosing a basis e₁,…,eₙ of V identifies Symᵏ(V) with homogeneous polynomials of degree k in n variables, of dimension C(n+k−1, k). The exterior algebra is its skew-commutative counterpart.
